title: Introduce provisioning-rate-limiter and utilization-loss-reconciler for dedicated fleets
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleet onboarding spikes and oscillatory provisioning have caused transient overshoot of node starts and increased preemption-induced throughput loss for multi-tenant pools. This PR adds two coordinated pieces: (1) a provisioning-rate-limiter in the control plane that smooths out node launch requests per-pool based on a velocity-aware token window, warm-pool occupancy, and recent failure signals; (2) a utilization-loss-reconciler that attributes lost effective throughput to provisioning/preemption events and reports a corrected per-tenant utilization metric used by the autoscaler and billing-reporter.

Summary of changes: added a new provisioner/ratelimit package that exposes a RateLimiter interface and an implementation ProvisionWindowLimiter which enforces a dynamic per-pool QPS of provisioning actions. The limiter uses EWMA of recent launches and a warm-pool factor to let bursts when warm capacity exists while preventing repeated start storms. The reconcilers/telemetry changes include a UtilLossReconciler service that listens to allocation events, preemption notices and reservation reconciliations to compute 'lost tokens' (tokens that would have been served absent preemptions or fractional deallocations). These are exposed as metrics (reconciler.lost_tokens_total, reconciler.reconciled_utilization_ratio) and a compact per-tenant CSV export for offline billing audits.

Implementation notes: - Rate limiter operates at the ProvisionCoordinator RPC boundary so decisions are deterministic and easy to audit. It supports a per-pool override map and a conservative default derived from fleet size and recent per-pool headroom. - The limiter has a bypass flag for emergency operator commands and for on-demand manual scaling via the console. - UtilLossReconciler relies on an event-sourced view (allocation events, preemption logs, and reservation adjustments) and performs a nightly reconciliation job to surface mismatches; a fast-path real-time sampler provides immediate feedback for autoscaler heuristics. - New config knobs: max_provision_rate_per_pool, provision_rate_ewma_alpha, warm_pool_burst_multiplier, reconciler_sampling_window_seconds, reconciler_min_event_threshold. Defaults are conservative (no behavior change for existing pools) and documented in config/README.

Testing & rollout: unit tests for limiter token mechanics and reconciler attribution were added. Integration test harness simulates 3 pool topologies (steady, ramp, flapping) and assertions verify limiter prevents >30% overshoot during synthetic ramp and that reconciler reports >=95% of known lost tokens in integration traces. Staged rollout: feature gate off by default; gradual enable across Canary->Staging->Prod with per-pool opt-in. Rollback plan: disable feature gate or set per-pool max_provision_rate_per_pool to very high value to restore previous behavior.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked: /docs/design/provisioning-rate-limiter.md - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration tests - [x] Metrics + dashboards (Grafana dashboard template added) - [x] Release notes entry added

Related: builds on prior autoscaler headroom work (ENG-3881) and complements the warm-pool prewarming improvements in ENG-3977. Not a breaking change: defaults preserve current behavior.

review_conversation: Marcus Nguyen: Can the limiter cause headroom starvation for pools with aggressive fractional reservations? Please include a safety check to avoid blocking guaranteed reservations.

Priya Shah: Good point — added a reservation bypass: guaranteed reservations and SLO-backed commit windows are exempt. See provisioner/coordination/coordinator.go:ReserveAndLaunch now checks bypass list.
Evelyn Ortega: Telemetry looks good; ensure reconciler only samples sensitive tenant IDs with redaction. We need PII hygiene.
Priya Shah: Reconciler exporter now redacts tenant identifiers in the CSV and emits a tenant hash for correlation. Updated exporter.go and added unit tests.
Samir Kulkarni: Integration tests pass locally but flake reproduced once in CI; investigator note attached.
Priya Shah: CI flake was due to time skew in test harness, tightened clock mocks and retried. All CI runs green after fix.
merge_outcome: Merged by Marcus Nguyen via squash and merge. Commit message summarises rate limiter and reconciler with reference to ENG-4128. Backported changelog entry added to release-notes/2024-11.
release_notes: Introduces a control-plane provisioning-rate-limiter to smooth dedicated fleet node launches and a utilization-loss-reconciler to attribute and report throughput lost to provisioning/preemption events. Feature is gated and off by default. Operators can opt-in per-pool. Metrics and dashboard templates included.
